title: Remote Work Policy v3 (Draft for Consultation)
content: DRAFT — NOT YET APPROVED. This document is circulated for internal feedback only and has no legal or policy effect. Proposal: employees would be permitted to work fully remotely with no minimum office attendance requirement. The rationale is to support talent retention in a competitive market. This draft is under review by the Executive Leadership Team and has not been approved. The current official policy remains remote_policy_v2 (three days per week limit). This draft should not be used as a basis for any employee's remote work arrangements until formally approved and assigned an effective date.
